question: How many times should the deity's six-syllable mantra be recited at minimum?
premises: The mantra to be recited is the six-syllable one.
The count should not be less than one hundred and eight.
inference: One should recite the six-syllable mantra no fewer than one hundred and eight times.
plain_english: One should recite my six-syllable mantra no fewer than one hundred and eight times.
